thread:
incident-bot: ALERT: p99 latency spike detected for /v1/stream (hosted). p95 also increased. SLO breach triggered. auto-annotation: prefix-cache hit_rate dropped below SLO threshold.
Alana: Seeing a huge drop in prefix cache hit rate right after the prefix-hash rollout from yesterday. hit_rate went from ~0.92 -> ~0.27 for streaming keys.
Samir: Ok. Quick triage: is this a cold-cache problem (warmup) or mis-hash (wrong prefix namespace)?
Natalie: Metrics snapshot: p95=420ms (normal ~120ms), p99=2.1s (normal ~350ms). Streaming stalls showing backlog in paging subsystem. Token throughput down ~18%.
Mike: Running quick kv stats on one hot shard:
```
$ redwood-admin kv-stats --shard=us-west-2-a --prefix=streaming_v1
prefix_hits: 2713
prefix_misses: 7321
hit_rate: 0.2703
evictions: 124
avg_lookup_ms: 2.1
paging_io_wait_ms: 85
```
Mike: That aligns with a namespace mismatch — lots of misses causing paging and backpressure to runtime.
Alana: The prefix-hash patch changed how we encode model+route -> prefix. If rollout toggled mapping, caches could be populated under old keys and now miss. We did a canary but maybe not full mapping.
Samir: Mitigation options: 1) route a portion of traffic to fallback model variant that uses old prefix mapping; 2) increase cache TTL and prewarm common prefixes; 3) rollback prefix-hash change. Which is least risky?
Natalie: I can flip routing rules to route 30% -> fallback-v1 within 2 mins. That should reduce p99 while we investigate. Customer impact estimate: affects ~2.4% of total reads but up to 15% of streaming sessions because streaming uses longer prefixes.
Mike: I can run a targeted prefetch script to warm top 200 prefixes. Will take ~5-7 mins to seed.
Evan: Any customer-facing outages? Have we seen 5xxs?
Natalie: Error rates are stable. No 5xx spike, just latency SLO breaches. So degradation only.
Samir: Ok do the fallback routing + prefetch now. If p99 doesn't drop to <800ms in 15 minutes, prepare rollback.
Natalie: executing route change now.
deploy-bot: deploy triggered by Natalie: routing-rule-update (route: /v1/stream -> fallback-v1:30%). CI checks passed.
deploy-bot: update complete. Routing change deployed to us-west-2.
Natalie: routing change live. Observing metrics...
Alana: Starting prefix warmup script for top prefixes from yesterday's logs.
Mike: Warmup logs:
```
prefetch started: 1993457005
prefetch hit primed: 178
prefetch primed: 200 prefixes
prefetch duration: 6.8s
```
Natalie: Initial numbers after mitigations: p95=190ms, p99=640ms. hit_rate bumped to ~0.52 for streaming prefixes. Still below normal but much better.
Samir: Good partial mitigation. Next steps: dig into prefix-hash mapping diff to see which keys changed mapping. Alana can we get the mapping delta?
Alana: Pulling mapping-diff between v1 and v1-rollout: found ~13% of prefixes remapped due to a canonicalization bug (trailing slash normalization). That explains why warm prefixes miss.
Evan: Customer impact: estimate 8% of active streaming sessions saw higher latency in last 90m. No data loss or 5xxs. Will notify CS with a brief note: degradation for streaming endpoints, mitigations applied, rollback candidate if symptoms persist.
Samir: Decision: keep routing change + warmup for now. Patch the canonicalization bug and re-run a canary mapping validator. If mapping diff is fixed, we can gradually roll forward with a recalculated warmup. If not fixed within 45m, rollback prefix-hash to previous release.
Alana: I'll draft PR for the canonicalization fix and run the mapping validator. ETA 20m.
Natalie: Monitoring alert will remain open; I'll watch p99 and hit_rate dashboards and update here.
Samir: Evan, taking on-call handoff in 10m — Samir -> Evan. Evan, quick summary: p99 spike due to prefix mapping change causing low cache hit rate; we've routed 30% to fallback-v1 and prewarmed top prefixes; p99 down from 2.1s to 640ms but still elevated; canonicalization bug PR in flight. If p99 climbs back above 1.2s, rollback.
Evan: Ack. I'll pick it up. Please post PR link and mapping diff when ready. I'll notify CS and set post-incident follow-up. :raising_hand:
Alana: PR: https://git.redwood/repo/changes/PR-4821 (canonicalization fix). mapping-diff gist: https://gist.github.com/redwood/abcd1234
Samir: Thanks everyone. I'll keep watch for 15 more mins then hand off fully.
Evan: I'll run a verification sweep across other regions and coordinate the rollback if necessary. Leaving note in runbook: https://docs.redwood/runbooks/prefix-hash-rollback
incident-bot: Incident annotated: mitigation applied (routing fallback, prefetch). Status: mitigated -> monitoring.
Samir: Handoff complete.
